title: Autonomous Vehicles & Mobility
businessQuestion: What sensor fusion mix delivers commercial safety verification at mass scale?
investorQuestion: How does robotaxi fleet economics reshape automotive OEM unit sales and software subscriptions?
overview: Autonomy's record set is small and unusually mature: most entries are in pilot or commercial deployment, reflecting a decade of road testing. The remaining bottleneck is regulatory approval and unit economics rather than core perception, so the sector is less about new capability than about who owns fleets, depots, insurance and the maintenance relationship.
